pitch.angle: After divesting its e‑commerce arm, Burris is sharpening focus on core cold‑storage and freight services. Deploying GND’s ThinxFresh cold‑chain platform and real‑time asset tracking can safeguard its 60 M cf freezer capacity, tighten regulatory compliance, and unlock efficiency across its three business units.
pitch.opener: I noticed Burris oversees 60 M cf of freezer space across 13 East‑Coast sites—imagine instantly seeing every pallet’s temperature and location from a single dashboard.
